name: minus_calibrated_gate
stratum: SC-OOD, SC-CLAIM, and SC-REC held-out episodes
hypothesis: Removing calibration increases autonomous coverage at the cost of a higher unsafe-task rate under ambiguity and shift.

name: minus_human_escalation
hypothesis: Replacing approval with forced autonomous action increases unsafe execution conditional on the same uncertain states.

name: minus_explicit_state_recovery
removed_mechanism: explicit state and monotonic recovery transition
hypothesis: Removing explicit recovery lowers completion and raises action-budget stops after an interrupted transition.
